Subject: Engagement frameset: initial GDoc + slide deck (week0 acceptance outline)

Hi Sara —

Great to meet last week. Per our conversation, I sketched a lightweight engagement frameset that blends a short MAP-style acceptance checklist with an initial technical validation plan. I attached two stubs: a GDoc for the collaborative MAP (olive-engagement-frameset-v0.1.gdoc) and a compact PPTX that visualizes the Week 0 acceptance matrix.

Key asks:
- Can you confirm engineering stakeholders (names + emails) we should include in Week 0?
- Confirm acceptance criteria priority: reliability (SLO), data residency proof points, and latency targets.

Proposed next step: 30-minute co-edit session to align owners and confirm the Week 0 test harness. I'm free Wed 21/11:00–12:30 PT or Thu 22/09:00–10:00 PT.

Notes on scope in the doc:
- Week 0: env prep, connectivity test, simple inference run (1k tokens/day), perf trace capture
- Week 1–2: eval scenarios, quantization trial, cost baseline

Attached: week0-acceptance-matrix.pptx (slide stubs)

—Kimberly

Thanks, this looks like a helpful starting point. Quick answers:
